2609.25001.title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
2609.25001.paper_summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.
2609.25001.paper_summary_zh: 現代視頻遊戲為人工智慧模型提供了一個可測量的測試平台，結合了視覺理解、指令分解、目標規劃和對多個時間範疇的精確行動控制的能力。 然而，現有的數據集和基準要麼涵蓋的遊戲範圍狹窄，要麼缺乏語言指令，或依賴於高變異的在線滾動。 為了解決這些挑戰，我們推出了GameHorizon，一個統一的數據和評估套件，用於測量不同模型系列在不同時間範疇的遊戲能力。 GameHorizon套件由三個組件組成。 首先，GameHorizon-Annotator是一個可擴展的自動化註釋管道，用於多時間範疇的指令。 其次，利用該管道，我們構建了GameHorizon-Data，這是第一個大規模的AAA遊戲數據集，包含時間對齊的視頻、玩家行動和多時間範疇的指令。 它包含來自21款遊戲的5,000小時錄音，由100名人類專家玩家收集。 第三，我們建立了GameHorizon-Bench，具有可重複的離線和逐步在線測試。 離線路徑使得使用成千上萬的標準化問題進行可重複評估成為可能，這些問題被組織成三個主要任務和一系列診斷變體，而在線路徑則測試離線分數是否反映實際的遊戲能力，並將失敗定位到長時間遊戲中的特定步驟。 基於我們的GameHorizon套件，我們通過超過一百萬次模型調用評估了47個模型，揭示了任務難度的有意義層次結構和模型能力的顯著差異。 我們的工作可以提供一個標準化的衡量標準，用於評估不同時間範疇和模型系列的遊戲能力。 我們將發布我們的數據集、註釋器和基準，以促進未來的研究。
